name: Paimon
source:
"Oh great lucifer, to the limits of my life I swear alliegince to you."
A demon who has sworn allegiance to Lucifer.
Under orders from Lucifer he makes a contract with the protagonist in order to strengthen her and to keep her away from other demons until the ring is at full power.
